tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Per the platform runbook, checkout-api was rolled back to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east only); a retry completed the rollout. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate 0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until the root cause is investigated; note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions
